Akihabara Station.official_name: JR Akihabara Station (Denki-gai / Electric Town exit)
Akihabara Station.what: The JR station exit facing the electronics district is called the Electric Town exit (Denki-gai-guchi); the other side is the Showa-dori exit. Kanda Myojin is about 7 minutes on foot from this exit, Mandarake Complex about 4 minutes, and Taito Station and GiGO Akihabara 3 about 3 minutes (walking times as stated by each spot's own site).
Akihabara Station.tip: Meet at the Electric Town exit, not the Showa-dori exit. No station hours were read, so the open flag is unknown (it is a public transit station, not a shop).

Kanda Myojin shrine.hours: Amulet/talisman office 9:00-18:00 (notice of 2026-09-28, valid through Dec 31, 2026). Grounds hours: not stated
Kanda Myojin shrine.what: Shrine that calls itself the chief guardian shrine of Edo; enshrines Daikoku-sama (Onamuchi), Ebisu-sama (Sukunahikona) and Taira no Masakado. Traditionally founded in 730 and moved to its present site in 1616. Hosts Kanda Matsuri every two years.
Kanda Myojin shrine.tip: The amulet office closes at 18:00, so buy omamori before then. The official site does not state when the grounds close and a live camera of the grounds runs 24 hours; formal prayer reception is listed only as 9:00-16:30 or 15:45 in January 2026 notices, so do not plan on a prayer ceremony at 16:00-19:00. Official site says 7 min on foot from the Electric Town exit.

mAAch ecute Kanda Manseibashi.official_name: mAAch ecute Kanda Manseibashi (mAAch ecute 神田万世橋)
mAAch ecute Kanda Manseibashi.hours: Stairs and platform areas 11:00-22:00 Mon-Sat (11:00-20:30 Sun/holidays); Open Deck 11:00-22:30 Mon-Sat. Shop hours vary by shop
mAAch ecute Kanda Manseibashi.closed: Facility closure days in 2026: Nov 9 (Mon), Dec 31 (Thu); none on Nov 5 or 6
mAAch ecute Kanda Manseibashi.what: Commercial facility built into the old Manseibashi railway viaduct (1912 Stairs, 1935 Stairs, Platform, Open Deck). The official shop list has 9 entries including a craft beer bar, an observation cafe/restaurant, a ramen shop, a gallery/diorama display, and accessories.
mAAch ecute Kanda Manseibashi.tip: Nov 5 and 6 are normal opening days (the next closure is Mon Nov 9). Individual shops differ: for example Les Nereides PARIS (accessories) closes at 19:00 and the Library gallery at 20:00, while the cafe/bar listings run into the evening.

Radio Kaikan.official_name: Akihabara Radio Kaikan (秋葉原ラジオ会館), 1-15-16 Sotokanda
Radio Kaikan.hours: Building 10:00-20:00 (B1F restaurant has its own later hours)
Radio Kaikan.closed: none listed (individual shops post temporary closures)
Radio Kaikan.what: Multi-floor hobby building, floors 0F-10F: 10F event space; 9F card shops; 8F and 7F doll, figure and trading card shops; 5F Lashinbang, Kaiyodo Hobby Lobby and others; 3F K-BOOKS; 2F and 1F hobby shops and a Family Mart; 0F a Ginza Lion restaurant.
Radio Kaikan.tip: Building closes at 20:00, so 16:00-19:00 is fine, but each shop sets its own hours. Official news page lists temporary closures of single shops (for example 5F Uchusen-sen, 1F Mach), so check the shop-news page before choosing a floor.

Akihabara Gachapon Kaikan.official_name: Gachapon Kaikan (ガチャポン会館), 3-15-5 Sotokanda MN Building 1F
Akihabara Gachapon Kaikan.what: Capsule-toy (gachapon) shop on the ground floor of the MN Building. The official site gives 2 minutes on foot from Suehirocho Station (Ginza Line) and 7 minutes from the JR Electric Town exit.
Akihabara Gachapon Kaikan.tip: Nov 5 and 6 are weekdays, so it should be open until 20:00. The site says the latest hours are posted on the shop's X account. It is about a 7 minute walk from the station, further than the shops on the main strip.

Super Potato.official_name: Super Potato Akihabara (スーパーポテト 秋葉原店), 1-11-2 Sotokanda Kitabayashi Building 3F-5F
Super Potato.what: Retro game shop on floors 3F-5F of the Kitabayashi Building. The store page describes 5F as a retro game arcade and rest area; it does not describe 3F and 4F.
Super Potato.tip: Store closes at 20:00, so the arcade on 5F is reachable during the tour window. The Akihabara store page has no store-specific notices at the time of checking; the mail-order desk (11:00-17:00, closed Sat/Sun) is separate and not relevant.

GiGO arcade.official_name: GiGO Akihabara 3 (GiGO秋葉原3号館), 1-11-11 Sotokanda, along Chuo-dori
GiGO arcade.hours: 10:00-23:30 every day including holidays (cafe last order 19:40)
GiGO arcade.what: Main GiGO on Chuo-dori: the official page gives 'along Chuo-dori, 3 minutes from the Electric Town exit' and lists crane games, print-sticker booths, driving, gun, music, video and card games, and capsule toys. The collab cafe listing shows it on floors 6-7 of the Sotokanda 1-chome building.
GiGO arcade.tip: Branches: GiGO Akihabara 1 closed on 2025-08-31 (its page no longer exists on the official site; closure was reported by the operator via news sites) and the operator said it continues with branches 2, 3 and 5. Branch 2: 1-15-1 (2F), Branch 5: 1-10-1 (1F). Use branch 3 for Chuo-dori; branch 5 for the Gundam EXVS2 machines moved from branch 1 (per news reports).
GiGO arcade.source: https://www.gigo.co.jp/shops/akihabara3 ; https://www.gigo.co.jp/shops/akihabara2 ; https://www.gigo.co.jp/shops/akihabara5 ; https://gamebiz.jp/news/409116 (closure of branch 1, news report)

Chuo-dori at night.official_name: Chuo-dori (中央通り), Akihabara Electric Town main street
Chuo-dori at night.what: The main street of the electric district. The pedestrian zone (car-free) runs every Sunday only: 13:00-17:00 from October to March, between the Sotokanda 5-chome intersection and Manseibashi intersection, about 570 m.
Chuo-dori at night.tip: Nov 5 and 6 are a Thursday and a Friday, so there is no pedestrian zone and traffic is on the road. Walk on the sidewalks. Nov 1, 8 and later Sundays are the days with the car-free street (and a sidewalk rest-area trial on Sundays 13:00-16:30), not this tour.

Animate Akihabara.official_name: Animate Akihabara (アニメイト秋葉原) - Building No.1, No.2 and ANNEX, 4-3-1 Sotokanda
Animate Akihabara.hours: No.1 and No.2 buildings 10:00-21:00 daily; ANNEX 10:00-21:00 weekdays, 10:00-20:00 weekends/holidays; Cafe Gratte+ ANNEX 12:00-20:00 weekdays (last order 19:30)
Animate Akihabara.what: Large anime goods store. After the renewal opened on 2026-08-08: No.1 building floors 1F-6F character goods; ANNEX B1-1F is a capsule-toy floor 'POP @P CAPSULE -AKIHABARA-', 2F-3F game titles and character goods, 4F-7F official shops and events.
Animate Akihabara.tip: Store was expanded and reopened on 2026-08-08, and now has a No.1 building, a No.2 building and an ANNEX; older blog posts may describe a different layout. Cafe Gratte on Thursday/Friday takes last order at 19:30.

Mandarake Complex.official_name: Mandarake Complex (まんだらけ コンプレックス), 3-11-12 Sotokanda; Complex 2 at 3-12-2 Sotokanda
Mandarake Complex.closed: open every day of the year
Mandarake Complex.what: Eight-floor Mandarake building. Floor guide on the shop page: 1F buyback, vintage Japanese pop items and cosplay; 2F Disney; 3F boys' comics and vintage; 4F men's doujin; 5F BL/girls' comics, idols, women's doujin, magical girl and dolls; 6F-8F toys, plastic models and figures.
Mandarake Complex.tip: Complex 2 (3-12-2, same 12:00-20:00 hours, card/game/CD/DVD floors) is a separate building next to it and, per the shop's own topics, had its 1st anniversary in September 2026. Opens at noon, so it is fully open at 16:00. Some floors sell adult material; check the floor guide before going up with a mixed group.

Lashinbang or Surugaya.official_name: Lashinbang AKIBA Flags (1-7-6 Sotokanda, AKIBA Culture ZONE 2F) and Surugaya Akihabara Honkan (駿河屋 秋葉原本館, 3-11-3 Sotokanda)
Lashinbang or Surugaya.hours: Lashinbang AKIBA Flags 11:00-21:00 daily (buyback 11:00-18:00); Lashinbang Radio Kaikan branch (5F) 10:00-20:00 (buyback 11:45-18:00); Surugaya Akihabara Honkan weekdays 11:00-21:00, weekends/holidays 10:00-21:00
Lashinbang or Surugaya.closed: Lashinbang: none (Radio Kaikan branch follows the building's days off); Surugaya: none listed
Lashinbang or Surugaya.what: Lashinbang AKIBA Flags sells character goods, scale figures, ichiban kuji, prize figures, plush and retro games. Surugaya Akihabara Honkan is an 8-floor building on 'Junk-dori' selling figures, toys, anime goods, trading cards and PC/doujin software; floors 5F and 6F are adult-only; 8F is an event space.
Lashinbang or Surugaya.tip: The official Lashinbang store list has no store named 'Akihabara main': it lists AKIBA Flags, the Radio Kaikan 5F branch and the adult 'AKIBA DEEP BASE' (4-4-3, 3F). Lashinbang AKIBA Flags is the one that matches 'main' as a general store, but this mapping is my reading, not stated by the site. Surugaya Akihabara Ekimae (1-15-15, B1-3F, 1 min from the station) has the same hours and is the closer option.

Akihabara Radio Center.official_name: Akihabara Radio Center (秋葉原ラジオセンター), 1-14-2 Sotokanda area, under the elevated tracks near the Electric Town exit
Akihabara Radio Center.what: Cluster of small parts and electronics shops in the arches under the tracks; the Akihabara Electric Town Promotion Association's site lists 'Radio Center' among shops taking part in the Oct 2026 Omotenashi fair. No official site with shared hours was found.
Akihabara Radio Center.tip: Each tenant sets its own hours. A non-official Akihabara guide blog (akihabara-bc.jp, not read directly because the page blocked access) gave roughly 10:00-19:00 for the center, so parts stalls may be closing around 19:00, but this is unconfirmed. Treat it as a short walk-through at the start of the window, not a 18:30 stop.
Akihabara Radio Center.source: https://akiba.or.jp/3833 (association page; lists Radio Center as a participating shop, no hours)

Taito Station and GiGO.official_name: Taito Station Akihabara (タイトーステーション 秋葉原店), 4-2-2 Sotokanda Kisan Building; also Taito Station Akihabara East-West Free Passage (秋葉原東西自由通路店)
Taito Station and GiGO.what: Taito Station Akihabara has a large Space Invaders sign; official floor guide: B1 print-sticker machines; 1F-3F crane games; 4F arcade, card, video and racing games and Taiko no Tatsujin; 5F music games. The East-West Free Passage store (Kanda Sakumacho 1-6-1, inside the station passage) is also 10:00-23:30, open every day.
Taito Station and GiGO.tip: Taito Station Akihabara is 3 min on foot from the Electric Town exit per the official page. The East-West Free Passage store is 0 minutes from the Electric Town exit and Central ticket gate, handy for a first stop. A separate Taito 'Hey' game center (store id 00001703) also exists in Akihabara; do not confuse it with Taito Station. For GiGO see the 'GiGO arcade' entry.
